# spc-medsafe (PHAROS fixture)

Medsafe, saved 6 November 2026, 23:57–23:59 Cairo.

* `datasheet.htm`: `https://www.medsafe.govt.nz/profs/Datasheet/datasheet.htm`, every data sheet (2,279 links).
* `updates.html`: `https://www.medsafe.govt.nz/other/Updates-Data-sheets-and-CMIs.asp`, the updates of 2026
  (84 dates, 1 November back to 3 January), data sheets and CMIs in separate tables.
* `panadolOsteocaplets.pdf`: `https://www.medsafe.govt.nz/profs/Datasheet/p/panadolOsteocaplets.pdf`, the
  Panadol Osteo data sheet, section 10 dated 11 June 2025.

Medsafe's searches (`/DbSearch/InfoSearch`, `/DbSearch/`) answer only through a live JavaScript connection
(Blazor Server): posted plainly with their token they return the empty form.
